author: dzinrz
title: Hiring Illustrators for Children's Books and Character Design
content: WE’RE HIRING ILLUSTRATORS! Are you a skilled illustrator with a passion for creativity and storytelling? We’d love to see your work! At The Dzinrz Illustration Studio, we bring stories to life through children’s book illustrations, character design, and a variety of creative projects. Who can apply? Anyone with strong illustration skills, creativity, and a passion for creating engaging artwork is welcome to apply. We value talent, creativity, and the willingness to grow! 📍 Location: Applicants from Gujrat, Pakistan, will be given priority. Remote work opportunities are also available for talented artists from other locations. 📩 How to apply: Send your portfolio or work samples to hello@thedzinrz.com 🌐 Visit www.thedzinrz.com to explore our portfolio and get a better understanding of the projects we work on. Know someone who loves illustration? Tag them or share this opportunity! Let’s create something amazing together. #TheDzinrz #IllustratorHiring #IllustrationJobs #GujratJobs #PakistanJobs RemoteIllustrator ChildrensBookIllustration CharacterDesign CreativeOpportunities freelancer

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists
content: 🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: * Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. * Ability to match an established cartoon art style. * Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). 📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to: * jobs@jumpanimation.com * gawad26@gmail.com 💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook! If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you! #Hiring #AnimationJobs #VectorArtist #BackgroundArtist #2DAnimation #AdobeIllustrator #AdobeAnimate #JUMPAnimation

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️ We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: -Name, general location -Position applying for -Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples -Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-) -Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary) -Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work -Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc) -Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use) -Other notable experience / specializations *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️ _________ ‼️CREATORS‼️ If you’re a creator looking for a new home, reach out to me DIRECTLY for more information about @lemoon.io .
